description:
APT processor generating a @Named @Singleton DataSource holder per named datasource, from
        @VidocqDataSources and from vidocq.pool.<name>.url keys in vidocq.properties /
        application.properties. OPTIONAL: declare this artifact in <annotationProcessorPaths>
        only when an application actually uses named datasources (multi-datasource) with the Mansart
        pool extension. Deliberately NOT named "*-extension-codegen": unlike the cassini / mansart-data
        codegens it is not a mandatory companion of the extension, so the checkpom must not force every
        pool consumer to declare it. Requires only java.compiler — emits plain Java sources.
